title: ContextTriageResult.v1
description: The output of the ContextTriageClassifier — the FIRST stage of the ContextOps loop. Given a piece of context (a fact_key, a claim, a source), it picks exactly one of the 12 triage lanes and sets needs_action. This is a DETECTION result, not a fact and not a decision: it never serves truth, never promotes anything, it only routes work. needs_action gates whether a bounded research agent is commissioned downstream. Deterministic when triaged_at is injected (no clock, no RNG).

triage_id.description: content-addressed over (fact_key, lane, source_scope); version lives in metadata, never in the id

source_scope.description: a triage of tenant_private context stays tenant-scoped — it can never widen to global

fact_key.description: the context/fact the triage is about (e.g. cfpb.error_resolution.investigation_deadline)

source_handle.description: the handle of the context being triaged (opaque source reference)

lane.description: exactly one of the 12 ContextTriage lanes — the single source of the lane taxonomy

needs_action.description: true when this lane warrants commissioning bounded research / verification work; false when the context is fine as-is

rationale.description: why this lane was chosen (the cue/authority/freshness reason); human-readable, never the answer itself

authority_rank.description: the current source's authority rank (lower-authority context is more likely to need reconciliation)

fragility_signal.description: cue that drove an is_fragile/is_stale lane (e.g. 'deadline', 'rate', 'stale_ttl')

recommended_command.description: the durable command this triage routes to — a recommendation only; agents/main decide, triage never executes

serves_truth.description: pinned false — a triage result is a routing signal, it can NEVER be served as a fact
